slug: 2025-03-19 Madagascar - Orange Launches Mobile App (Orange Money Pro) for Business Transactions

MDG.note: Orange Money Pro is a private merchant app, not public procurement.
No consumer protection rules or redress stated.
No government payments to people stated.
No survey share of adults with an account stated.

facts.fact: Orange Madagascar introduced Orange Money Pro on 18 March 2025, a mobile money app for merchants and distributors offering QR-code payments and payment links, downloaded more than 10,000 times per Google Play.

MDG.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
